The '''37th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2026 Producers Guild Awards''' or '''2026 PGA Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2025, were held at the [[The Century Plaza Hotel|Fairmont Century Plaza]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] on February 28, 2026.<ref>{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title=Producers Guild Announces Key Dates for the 2026 Producers Guild Awards |url=https://producersguild.org/awards-date-timeline-2026/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=April 21, 2025 |access-date=November 11, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Hipes |first1=Patrick |last2=Hipes |first2=Erik |title=PGA Awards Reveal 2026 Date & Timeline |url=https://deadline.com/2025/04/2026-pga-awards-date-timeline-producers-guild-1236373231/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=November 12, 2025 |date=April 21, 2025}}</ref> The nominees in the documentary category were announced on December 9, 2025,<ref name="DocumentaryNominationsPGA">{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title=Producers Guild of America Announces 2026 Award Nominees for Documentary Motion Pictures and Finalists for PGA Innovation Award |url=https://producersguild.org/2026-pga-awards-documentary-motion-pictures-nominees-pga-innovation-award-finalists/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=December 9, 2025 |access-date=December 10, 2025}}</ref><ref name="DocumentaryNominationsTHR">{{cite web |last1=Verhoeven |first1=Beatrice |title=2026 PGA Documentary Award Nominees Include ''The Alabama Solution'', ''The Perfect Neighbor'' |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2026-pga-documentary-award-nominees-1236445801/ |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=December 10, 2025 |date=December 9, 2025}}</ref> the nominations in the sports, children's, and short-form categories were announced on December 12, 2025,<ref>{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title=2026 Producers Guild Award Nominees Announced for Sports, Children's, and Short-Form Programs |url=https://producersguild.org/2026-pga-awards-sports-childrens-and-short-form-nominees/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=December 12, 2025 |access-date=December 19, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Schneider |first1=Michael |title=''Phineas and Ferb'', ''Sesame Street'', ''100 Foot Wave'' Among Producers Guild Awards Nominees in Sports, Children's and Short-Form |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/producers-guild-awards-nominees-sports-childrens-short-form-1236607791/ |access-date=December 19, 2025 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=December 12, 2025}}</ref> and the remaining nominations for film and television were announced on January 9, 2026.<ref>{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title=Producers Guild of America Announces 2026 Award Nominees for Motion Picture and Television Program Categories |url=https://producersguild.org/2026-pga-awards-motion-pictures-and-television-categories-nominees/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=January 9, 2026 |access-date=January 12, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Lewis |first1=Hilary |title=Producers Guild Awards Movie Nominations Include ''F1'', ''One Battle After Another'', ''Sentimental Value'', ''Sinners'', ''Weapons'' |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2026-producers-guild-awards-movie-tv-nominations-list-1236468468/ |access-date=January 12, 2026 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=January 9, 2026}}</ref> The finalists for the PGA Innovation Award were announced on December 9, 2025.<ref name="DocumentaryNominationsPGA" /><ref name="DocumentaryNominationsTHR" />

The PGA Innovation Award was presented on February 26, 2026, at a reception in Los Angeles.<ref name="DocumentaryNominationsPGA" /><ref name="DocumentaryNominationsTHR" />
